== Description ==
Players Committee gallery image of [[Combat Readiness (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court) (PC Gallery Text)|Combat Readiness (V)]], present in the Internet Archive capture of 3 December 2007 at 10:52:55 UTC. It shows the earlier remastered gallery wording recorded on that page. The capture establishes that the image was available by that time, not its first publication day.
